article.title: Ideogram 4.6加入精確編輯API，可用遮罩限定修改範圍
article.summary: Ideogram推出4.6模型，提供Generate及Precise Edit API，用於生成及連續修改圖片。
highlights: Precise Edit可加入遮罩指定修改位置，並保留來源圖片尺寸。
模型支援最高4K輸出，Very low品質模式上限為2K。
article.why: 商品圖需要局部改背景或顏色時，團隊可評估遮罩編輯能否保留包裝文字和其他未指定區域。
article.next_step: 固定一張商品圖及一塊背景遮罩，比較不同品質設定的文字、邊緣和檔案尺寸，再決定哪種設定可進入素材流程。
article.detail: Ideogram列出Very low、Low、Medium及High四種API品質設定，生成與編輯的計費亦按設定及尺寸而異。使用者可把上次編輯結果作為下一次輸入。團隊可以逐次保存原圖、遮罩和輸出，比較連續修改後哪些商品細節改變，再決定是否把這條流程接入既有批次製作。
article.title_en: Ideogram 4.6 adds precise-edit APIs with optional masks
article.summary_en: Ideogram released 4.6 with Generate and Precise Edit APIs for generation and successive edits.
highlights_en: Precise Edit can use a mask to limit edits and preserves source dimensions.
Output reaches 4K, while Very low quality is limited to 2K.
article.why_en: Product-image teams can assess whether masked edits preserve packaging text and unselected areas.
article.next_step_en: Use one product image and background mask to compare text, edges and dimensions across quality settings.
article.detail_en: The API lists four quality levels, with pricing depending on settings, size and operation. An edit can become the next input. Keep source, mask and output versions to assess detail changes before connecting the workflow to batch production.
